resources.string: Your real-time public transport planner for Metrovalencia. Fast, clean and tracking-free.
Check arrivals, plan trips and follow the service status of all 10 metro and tram lines.
Pick origin and destination, leave now or arrive by a given time, and see which lines to take, where to change and how long it takes. Real schedules from FGV\'s API.
Save your usual stops and routes, give them a name and get service alerts before you leave.
Explore the full Metrovalencia network, zoom into stations and open the PDF map.
Why does it ask for location?
Only to show your position on the map and find the closest stops. Your location never leaves your device.
